crossRefs.note: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As…
He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
translations.bsb: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
translations.asv: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judaea beyond the Jordan;
